description: Train V11_3 with Reward V5 from scratch for 20000 rounds against coin_collector_agent. V11 planner, pressure scoring, HOLD pooling and block priority are unchanged; the discounted pressure threshold is 0.30. At a certified safe HOLD, WAIT receives +1 and every non-WAIT action receives -1 in addition to existing unsafe/invalid penalties; all other rewards remain V4. Train world/agent seeds 21/20021, alpha 0.1 with visit-decay power 0.60, gamma 0.95 and sampled 5-step Q-learning. Epsilon reaches 0.05 after 15000 completed rounds and stays there for the final 5000 rounds. Checkpoints every 100 rounds retain canonical state-action update counts. Evaluate on five held-out seed pairs, 200 rounds each, with existing diagnostics and no replays.
